svg.title: Proposed prototype validation workflow
svg.desc: This editorial workflow organises the draft validation programme. It is not a normative protocol message sequence and does not claim that a working prototype or completed measurements already exist.

span.p: Freeze draft version, test scope and acceptance criteria

span.p: Publish exact PCM, DSD and protocol test vectors

span.p: Measure both clock families, FIFO behaviour and conversion timing

span.p: Inject corruption, gaps, stale frames and reference loss
